newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-TILLEKERATNE CENTURY PUTS SRI LANKA ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TILLEKERATNE CENTURY PUTS SRI LANKA ON TOP.

text.p: home test century as Sri Lanka took command of the second test
He made 100 not out and guided his team to a second day
Tillekeratne completed his fifth test century, his first in
Sri Lanka, in the final over of the day.
The left-hander batted for 335 minutes and faced 254 balls
in his chanceless innings. He struck 12 fours.
Tillekeratne arrived at 102 for four after captain Arjuna
Ranatunga fell cheaply to left-arm fast bowler Bryan Strang.
Ranatunga lasted only seven overs before mistiming a drive
to mid-on with his score on six.
Asanka Gurusinha and Tillekeratne added 114 for the fifth
